item.title: CakePHP problem with mod_rewrite
item.description:
Hello, good evening. Today I had problems with CakePHP URL rewriting, and decided to share the error and how I solved it.

The problem was that when I tried to access the application’s URL through the browser, it returned the following error 404 – Not Found.

Well, first, after looking for inconsistencies in controller and action names, clearing the cache, checking whether URL rewriting was enabled in Apache, etc, I turned to Google. After some research, I found the solution in Cake’s own documentation.

item.title: What is XAMPP and what is it for?
item.description:
Hello, let me introduce you to my favorite package (Apache + PHP + MySQL). This is how I started; today I install them separately.

What is XAMPP?

XAMPP is a package that includes the main open-source servers available, including FTP, the MySQL database and Apache with support for the PHP and Perl languages. With it you can run well-known CMSs such as WordPress and Drupal on the local machine (on your own computer), speeding up development.
